label: Improve Writing
prompt: Improve the writing of the text the user provides: make it clearer and better phrased while keeping its meaning, language and tone.

label: Fix Grammar & Spelling
prompt: Fix grammar, spelling and punctuation in the text the user provides. Keep the wording otherwise unchanged.

label: Make Longer
prompt: Expand the text the user provides with more detail while keeping its meaning and tone.

label: Make Shorter
prompt: Make the text the user provides more concise without losing its meaning.

label: Simplify Language
prompt: Simplify the language of the text the user provides so it is easier to read, keeping the meaning.

label: Rephrase
prompt: Rephrase the text the user provides, keeping its meaning and language.

label: Continue Writing
prompt: Continue writing from where the text the user provides stops, matching its style, language and tone. Return only the continuation.
